purpose: Teach: 勤勉/トラベル/平易/気概/描ける/むい/夏目/偶像

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「勤勉さは家族で受け継ぐ財産」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad was saying that hard work is a treasure a family hands down.
lines.style: Gentle, unhurried relaying; a proud warmth on the father's words, soft eye-level tone.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと家族トラベルプランを立てたよ
lines.en: Mei, guess what — Dad and I made a plan for our family trip!
lines.style: Small voice bursting its banks; quick proud rush, a breathless little lift on the plan.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「子供にも平易な言葉で説明する」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said he always explains things in plain, simple words so kids understand too.
lines.style: Soft and even; slowing kindly on the simple-words part, smiling through the quote.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「気概を持って進むよ」って約束したよ
lines.en: Mei, I promised Dad I'd keep going forward with real spirit!
lines.style: Earnest little chest-out declaration; careful on the big word, sincere rising finish.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「君が描ける絵を見たい」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad said he wants to see the pictures you can draw.
lines.style: Tender, conspiratorial lean-in; the wish delivered gently, letting the encouragement land soft.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと果物の皮をむいて朝食食べたよ
lines.en: Mei, Dad and I peeled the fruit ourselves and ate it for breakfast!
lines.style: Happy quick patter; proud emphasis on doing it together, a bright bounce at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが夏目漱石の三四郎を持ち歩いてらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad carries a Natsume Soseki novel around with him — Sanshiro.
lines.style: Quiet amusement at the detail; unhurried, a fond lilt on the book's title.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんに「偶像、つまり偶像崇拝は本質を見失う」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mei, Dad taught me that worshipping idols makes you lose sight of what's really real.
lines.style: Slow, careful recitation of a grown-up lesson; solemn child gravity, proud sincere close.
